testedReleaseAssembly.runnerPreparation: Copy each probe's Debug output to an isolated artifact runner, then overlay all published self-contained Release app contents. Original bin directories remain unchanged. UI and geometry runs load the exact published Release assembly.

builds.evidence: Completed tool build results; the persisted runtime logs contain outcome results and do not include build summaries.

subjects: Quiet idle state and exclusion of disabled or unavailable activities
Stable shared activity identity across compact, activity and detail presentations
Independent focus and countdown state with stale-action rejection
Only concurrent real activities produce minimal secondary bubbles
Single morphing black envelope with adaptive activity height
Spring retargeting, rapid reversals, suppression and reduced motion
Seek cancellation on capability loss, unknown duration and track replacement
Real in-flight Downloads and AI activity through isolated blocking HTTP handlers
Integration consent, cancellation, scratch cleanup and correct detail routing
Keyboard entry and escape, theme legibility and Settings viewport bounds
Correct fixture raster proportions and one visible primary activity action
newContextualCoverage.optionalServiceNetwork: Test-only handlers; no external network request.

renders.coverage: Ten module/context routes in light and dark, compact presentations, ten Settings pages at 960 and 700 widths in light and dark, System/Ocean/Forest/Rose samples, and eight explicitly labeled isolated activity fixtures including genuine running Timer, Due Reminder, known/unknown-size Download and busy AI states.
renders.additionalRenders: 16 productivity and 4 date/time DPI fixtures in the UI result directory.
observations: Activity envelopes retain their actual proportions and readable content.
The concurrent compact fixture includes the complete circular right media bubble.
Focus and Timer activity views each have one visible primary action; the Timer clock glyph renders correctly.
Reminder, Download and AI expanded headers show concise context hints instead of repeating full body text.
The known-size download frame shows 25% and 64 KB of 256 KB with a quarter-filled progress bar, derived from 65,536 real written bytes of a declared 262,144-byte response.
The unknown-size download remains an actual connecting 0 B state without a fabricated percentage; the busy AI frame shows pending local model status without the prompt.
Sampled light and dark Settings first viewports show legible controls and fixed footers.
renders.rasterCorrection: VisualBrush uses the visual's absolute parent offset and actual width/height as its absolute Viewbox; the opaque-bounds regression checks that the envelope is neither stretched nor cropped.

limitations: Static WPF fixtures are not physical desktop screenshots.
Settings renders cover the first scroll viewport per page.
No 60/120 FPS or compositor frame-time claim is supported.
Geometry checks exercise diagnostic parsing and pure calculations, not physical display transitions or mixed-DPI acceptance.
These runs do not qualify desktop visibility, physical OLE dragging, hardware media/audio/brightness integrations, audible playback or screen-reader acceptance.
The 11 omitted native clipboard-writing outcomes are not passed outcomes.
